description: A TypeScript source file defining a Settings Store class for managing application settings in the Notesnook project, including configuration retrieval, updates, and synchronization with external systems.

classes.name: SettingStore
classes.description: A class extending BaseStore to manage application settings, including retrieval, updates, and synchronization with external systems.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes the store state with current settings from the database and external integrations.

methods.name: setDateFormat
methods.description: Sets the date format in the settings and updates the database.

methods.name: setTimeFormat
methods.description: Sets the time format in the settings and updates the database.

methods.name: setDayFormat
methods.description: Sets the day format in the settings and updates the database.

methods.name: setWeekFormat
methods.description: Sets the week format in the settings and updates the database.

methods.name: setTitleFormat
methods.description: Sets the title format in the settings and updates the database.

methods.name: setTrashCleanupInterval
methods.description: Sets the trash cleanup interval in the settings and updates the database.

methods.name: setZoomFactor
methods.description: Sets the zoom factor in the application and updates the external system.

methods.name: setProxyRules
methods.description: Sets proxy rules in the external system.

methods.name: setEncryptBackups
methods.description: Enables or disables backup encryption and updates the configuration.

methods.name: setHomepage
methods.description: Sets the homepage configuration.

methods.name: setDefaultSidebarTab
methods.description: Sets the default sidebar tab in the settings.

methods.name: setImageCompression
methods.description: Sets image compression options.

methods.name: setDesktopIntegration
methods.description: Updates desktop integration settings.

methods.name: setNotificationSettings
methods.description: Updates notification settings.

methods.name: toggleEncryptBackups
methods.description: Toggles backup encryption setting.

methods.name: setBackupReminderOffset
methods.description: Sets backup reminder offset.

methods.name: setFullBackupReminderOffset
methods.description: Sets full backup reminder offset.

methods.name: setBackupStorageLocation
methods.description: Sets backup storage location.

methods.name: toggleDoubleSpacedParagraphs
methods.description: Toggles double-spaced paragraphs setting.

methods.name: toggleMarkdownShortcuts
methods.description: Toggles markdown shortcuts setting.

methods.name: toggleFontLigatures
methods.description: Toggles font ligatures setting.

methods.name: togglePrivacyMode
methods.description: Toggles privacy mode and updates external system.

methods.name: toggleCustomDns
methods.description: Toggles custom DNS setting and updates external system.

methods.name: toggleHideTitle
methods.description: Toggles note title visibility.

methods.name: toggleAutoUpdates
methods.description: Toggles auto-update setting.

methods.name: toggleFullOfflineMode
methods.description: Toggles full offline mode and manages related database actions.

methods.name: setServerUrls
methods.description: Sets server URLs configuration.

methods.name: toggleInbox
methods.description: Enables or disables inbox feature, managing API keys and user confirmation.
